items.description: Kitchen AC replacement, including installation and delivery
items.rationale: Section 2.3.10(c) excludes lightning-surge damage to climate-control equipment within five metres of a cooking appliance without the kitchen climate endorsement; the pictured unit is within that distance and no endorsement applies. Under §§7.1.11 and 9.5, installation and delivery follow the excluded replacement, leaving €0 payable for the combined line; €2,400 is the conditional gross estimate for the one documented unit.
